unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Set up a screen for someone who struggles to read it
drDigitalIntro:
A friend tells you they can see the screen, but reading it wears them out by lunchtime.
• They want the words heavier and larger, and less glare from bright white pages.
• You know four settings that would help. Use the ones you think are right.
• There is no step-by-step guide this time — the checklist shows what still needs doing.
• Take your time and look at the screen after each change.

playgroundTask.goal: You set up a screen that is easier to read for a long stretch

steps.say: The text on the computer is larger.
Pale and dark colors are further apart.
The screen has a warmer, less glaring tint.

playgroundTask.hint: Three of the four live on one page of Settings, in the list on the left. Look for the section named after this unit's subject.

drDigitalSuccess: That is a screen someone could read all afternoon. You chose every one of those settings yourself.
drDigitalHint: Everything you need is in Settings. Open the Hint if you want a nudge toward the right page.
